ANSWER: الضمير المناسب هو "هم".
FINAL: C
message.reasoning_content: We need correct pronoun replacing blank: "نَحْنُ طالِبانِ و [فراغ] مُعَلِّمانِ." We are "we are students and ___ teachers." Since "we" includes speaker, plural masculine? The second part refers to "we" also? Actually sentence: "We are students and ___ teachers." Should be "we are also teachers" so pronoun referring to "we" again: "نحن ... ونحن معلمون". The pronoun for "we" is "نحن". But options: هن (they fem), هما (they dual), هم (they masc), هي (she), هو (he). None is "نحن". Maybe they want pronoun for "they" referring to "students"? Actually structure: "نحن طلاب و [فراغ] معلمون." Could be "they are teachers"? But grammar: "We are students and they are teachers." That would be "هم". So answer C.
